description: Start a Dropscan sync and return IMMEDIATELY with a job_id — the work runs in the background (a full content pass takes minutes). Poll get_dropscan_sync_status for the result. It upserts mailings, stores each scan's PDF + envelope + Dropscan's OCR text (also for status='destroyed' — only the paper is shredded, the scan stays available), derives sender/subject, flags Behördenpost, and raises a HIGH-priority todo for any Frist or Termin found. Never files, forwards or destroys anything. Optional: max_pages (100 mailings/page, default 1), max_fetches (content downloads this run, default 25), refresh=true to re-read already-stored mailings (least-recently-fetched first, so repeated runs advance), mailing_id to re-read exactly one. One sync per tenant at a time.

max_fetches.description: Maximum content downloads in this run (default 25)

max_pages.description: Number of mailing pages to read, 100 mailings each (default 1)

refresh.description: Re-read already stored mailings, least recently fetched first

name: sync_dropscan
